criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: The user is asking for basic facts, definitions, or general information about COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: The user is asking about COVID-19 symptoms, how to identify them, or whether they should get tested.

categories.name: Transmission and Prevention
categories.definition: The user is asking how COVID-19 spreads or how to protect themselves and others from infection.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure
categories.definition: The user is asking about available treatments, potential cures, or medical advice for COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel and Restrictions
categories.definition: The user is asking about travel safety, restrictions, or high-risk areas related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Animal and Pet Related
categories.definition: The user is asking about COVID-19 transmission to or from animals/pets, or how to protect them.

categories.name: Statistics and Current Situation
categories.definition: The user is asking for current data, news, or updates on COVID-19 cases, deaths, or developments in specific regions.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: The user is asking to confirm or debunk common myths or misinformation about COVID-19.

categories.name: Donation and Contribution
categories.definition: The user is expressing an intent to donate money, materials, or support to COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing Information/Service
categories.definition: The user is expressing an intent to share the provided information or the service itself with others.

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: The user is expressing a greeting, thanks, or general positive sentiment towards the service.
